elbow_flex.source: ACE Bicep Curl: start with elbows extended, curl the bar/dumbbells toward the shoulders (start taken as 5 degrees, a slight bend); PMC6047503 (EMG study of curl variants) measured the dumbbell curl's excursion at 123.1 +/- 12.3 degrees, so the end is the 5-degree start plus that excursion, about 128 degrees

shoulder_flex.source: ACE Bicep Curl: keep the elbows next to the middle of the body; ACE Seated Biceps Curl: bend the elbow without moving it forward

torso_lean.source: ACE Bicep Curl: keep the chest still, using just the arms for the movement

muscles.peakSource: PMC6047503 (EMG of dumbbell curl variants): biceps activity climbs through the lift and is highest in the top hold, before easing on the way down

mistake.name: Swing and drift

tells.text: The torso rocks back to sling the weight up.
The elbows swing forward off the ribs.

mistake.source: BuiltWithScience biomechanics test (Coach Kassem): elbows swaying forward (shoulder flexion) cuts biceps activation and hands the rep to the front delts; ACE Bicep Curl: keep the chest still, using just the arms

sources: Contact fact (D-FG7 (j), both arms together): grip stays supinated, palms forward, for the whole rep (ACE Bicep Curl); no wrist_pron range is kept, since the side view does not draw that channel (D-FG7 (l))
